paragraphs: Rabbi. See R' Yehudah Ha-Nasi. [Glosses: Rabbi. (1) Pesahim 113a: Rabbi said, ‘R' Yehoshua ben Levi said three things in the name of the people of Jerusalem.’ It needs examination how Rabbi could speak in the name of his pupil's pupil, for Levi was Rabbi's pupil. Not corrected [ל״ת, provisionally “not corrected”, here and below]. (2) At Hullin 51a, Rav Avira describes himself as the one who gathered and dismissed the students at the academy of Rabbi the Great. Rashi explains: R' Yehudah Ha-Nasi. Yuhasin disagrees with Rashi: how could he have been before Rabbi and before Abaye and Rava? Not corrected. (3) Shabbat 113, end of b: R' Shmuel bar Nahmani said that Rabbi said, ‘Under,’ etc. Rabbi is superfluous; it is likewise absent in Ein Yaakov and the new Shas.]
